
---
title: "SHAP gap decomposition"
format: html
---


```{r}
# Load packages
library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
````

```{r}

### Raw XGBoost model SHAP

# Define all cohorts/age-sex groups to process
age_bins <- c(
  "female_50-54","female_55-59","female_60-64","female_65-69",
  "male_50-54","male_55-59","male_60-64","male_65-69"
)

# Loop over each cohort and process the raw SHAP values
shap <- lapply(age_bins, function(age){
    
    # Read SHAP values for this cohort
    shap <- fread(file.path("/XBoost_results/", age, "shap_values.csv"))

    # Convert from wide format to long format:
    # one row per person-feature combination
    shap <- melt(shap, id.vars = c("pred", "y", "baseline"))

    # Calculate mean SHAP value, mean prediction, and count
    # separately for deaths (y=1) and survivors (y=0)
    shap <- shap[
      ,
      .(
        shap_val = mean(value),
        mean_pred = mean(pred),
        count = .N
      ),
      by = c("y", "variable", "baseline")
    ]

    # Convert back to wide format so deaths and survivors are side by side
    shap <- dcast(
      shap,
      variable + baseline ~ y,
      value.var = c("shap_val", "mean_pred", "count")
    )

    # Difference in mean SHAP values:
    # deaths minus survivors
    shap[, shap := shap_val_1 - shap_val_0]

    # Sort by largest positive contribution to the gap
    setorder(shap, -shap)

    # Group variables into broader categories
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_cost|hc_util|hc_hospitalizations|se_long_term"), group1 := "Healthcare costs & utilization"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_di|hc_charlson|hc_elix"), group1 := "Heathcare dx"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "med_|medication_count"), group1 := "Psychiatric medications"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "se_hh|se_pers|se_educ"), group1 := "Economic characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "year|month"), group1 := "Year & month of birth"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "sex"), group1 := "Sex"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "de_marital"), group1 := "Marital status"]
    shap[variable == "de_imigration_status", group1 := "Immigration status"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "fa_num_child|fa_hh_size|_died"), group1 := "Family characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "imigration|ethnicity"), group1 := "Immigration"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "parish|region"), group1 := "Parish characteristics"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group1 := "Residual"]

    # Print variables that were not assigned to a group
    print(shap[is.na(group1)]$variable)

    # Group variables by timing window
    shap[, group2 := "Immediate"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_1_5$"), group2 := "Proximal"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_6_10$|_11_15$"), group2 := "Distal"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group2 := "Residual"]

    # Add cohort label
    shap[, age_bin := age]

    # Calculate mortality rate in the SHAP sample
    shap[, mort_rate := count_1 / (count_1 + count_0)]

    return(shap)
}) %>% 
  rbindlist()

# Print summary by cohort
print(unique(shap[, .(age_bin, mean_pred_0, mean_pred_1, count_0, count_1, mort_rate)]))

# Save combined raw SHAP results
fwrite(shap, "/XBoost_results/shap_results_all.csv")
```

```{r}

### Calibrated model SHAP

# Define all cohorts/age-sex groups to process
age_bins <- c(
  "female_50-54","female_55-59","female_60-64","female_65-69",
  "male_50-54","male_55-59","male_60-64","male_65-69"
)

# Loop over each cohort and process calibrated SHAP values
shap <- lapply(age_bins, function(age){
    
    # Read calibrated SHAP values for this cohort
    shap <- fread(file.path("/XBoost_results/", age, "calibrated_shap_values.csv"))

    # Print cohort name and column names as a check
    print(age)
    print(names(shap))

    # Convert from wide to long format
    shap <- melt(shap, id.vars = c("pred", "y", "baseline"))

    # Calculate average SHAP value and prediction by outcome group
    shap <- shap[
      ,
      .(
        shap_val = mean(value),
        mean_pred = mean(pred),
        count = .N
      ),
      by = c("y", "variable", "baseline")
    ]

    # Put deaths and survivors side by side
    shap <- dcast(
      shap,
      variable + baseline ~ y,
      value.var = c("shap_val", "mean_pred", "count")
    )

    # SHAP gap: deaths minus survivors
    shap[, shap := shap_val_1 - shap_val_0]

    # Sort by contribution to the gap
    setorder(shap, -shap)

    # Group variables into broader categories
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_cost|hc_util|hc_hospitalizations|se_long_term"), group1 := "Healthcare costs & utilization"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_di|hc_charlson|hc_elix"), group1 := "Heathcare dx"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "med_|medication_count"), group1 := "Psychiatric medications"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "se_hh|se_pers|se_educ"), group1 := "Economic characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "year|month"), group1 := "Year & month of birth"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "sex"), group1 := "Sex"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "de_marital"), group1 := "Marital status"]
    shap[variable == "de_imigration_status", group1 := "Immigration status"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "fa_num_child|fa_hh_size|_died"), group1 := "Family characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "imigration|ethnicity"), group1 := "Immigration"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "parish|region"), group1 := "Parish characteristics"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group1 := "Residual"]

    # Print variables without group
    print(shap[is.na(group1)]$variable)

    # Group variables by timing window
    shap[, group2 := "Immediate"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_1_5$"), group2 := "Proximal"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_6_10$|_11_15$"), group2 := "Distal"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group2 := "Residual"]

    # Add cohort label
    shap[, age_bin := age]

    # Mortality rate not calculated here because calibrated SHAP sample may be balanced
    # shap[, mort_rate := count_1 / (count_1 + count_0)]

    return(shap)
}) %>% 
  rbindlist()

# Print summary by cohort
print(unique(shap[, .(age_bin, mean_pred_0, mean_pred_1, count_0, count_1)]))

# Save combined calibrated SHAP results
fwrite(shap, "/XBoost_results/calibrated_shap_results_all.csv")
```

```{r}

### Baseline sensitivity SHAP

# Different baseline sample sizes to compare
baseline_sizes <- c(500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 30000)

# Loop over each baseline size
shap <- lapply(baseline_sizes, function(bs){
    
    # Read SHAP values for this baseline size
    shap <- fread(file.path(
      "/XBoost_results/female_65-69",
      paste0(bs, "_shap_values.csv")
    ))

    # Convert from wide to long format
    shap <- melt(
      shap,
      id.vars = c("pred", "y", "base_value", "baseline_size")
    )

    # Calculate average SHAP values by outcome and feature
    shap <- shap[
      ,
      .(
        shap_val = mean(value),
        mean_pred = mean(pred),
        count = .N
      ),
      by = c("y", "variable", "baseline_size", "base_value")
    ]

    # Put deaths and survivors side by side
    shap <- dcast(
      shap,
      variable + baseline_size + base_value ~ y,
      value.var = c("shap_val", "mean_pred", "count")
    )

    # SHAP gap: deaths minus survivors
    shap[, shap := shap_val_1 - shap_val_0]

    # Sort by contribution to the gap
    setorder(shap, -shap)

    # Group variables into broader categories
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_cost|hc_util|hc_hospitalizations|se_long_term"), group1 := "Healthcare costs & utilization"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "hc_di|hc_charlson|hc_elix"), group1 := "Heathcare dx"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "med_|medication_count"), group1 := "Psychiatric medications"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "se_hh|se_pers|se_educ"), group1 := "Economic characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "year|month"), group1 := "Year & month of birth"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "sex"), group1 := "Sex"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "de_marital"), group1 := "Marital status"]
    shap[variable == "de_imigration_status", group1 := "Immigration status"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "fa_num_child|fa_hh_size|_died"), group1 := "Family characteristics"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "imigration|ethnicity"), group1 := "Immigration"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "parish|region"), group1 := "Parish characteristics"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group1 := "Residual"]

    # Print variables without group
    print(shap[is.na(group1)]$variable)

    # Group variables by timing window
    shap[, group2 := "Immediate"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_1_5$"), group2 := "Proximal"]
    shap[str_detect(variable, "_6_10$|_11_15$"), group2 := "Distal"]
    shap[variable == "Residual", group2 := "Residual"]

    # Add cohort label
    shap[, cohort := "female_65-69"]

    # Calculate mortality rate in the SHAP sample
    shap[, mort_rate := count_1 / (count_1 + count_0)]

    return(shap)
}) %>% 
  rbindlist()

# Print summary for each baseline size
print(unique(shap[, .(
  baseline_size,
  base_value,
  mean_pred_0,
  mean_pred_1,
  count_0,
  count_1,
  mort_rate
)]))

# Save baseline sensitivity results
fwrite(shap, "/XBoost_results/shap_results_baseline_sensitivity.csv")
